subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular installer architecture now, and must `openclaw.ai/install.sh` remain a generated or preserved single-file public artifact?
rationale: The request is maintainability cleanup on a stable first-run setup surface, while current docs, tests, and website sync assume one served installer script.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded split
options.body: Approve an incremental split only if it preserves or generates the single public installer artifact and updates the website sync and installer proof path.

options.title: Allow bug-driven extractions only
options.body: Keep the issue as backlog guidance and extract sections only when a concrete installer bug or validation improvement needs it.

options.title: Keep the script monolithic
options.body: Decide that the served shell installer should stay single-file to minimize helper-loading and packaging risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a guarded split
recommendation.body: Approve an incremental split only if it preserves or generates the single public installer artifact and updates the website sync and installer proof path.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and import history make this the strongest current-code routing signal for the installer artifact shape.
